what_happened: Style/layout 5 (over-the-range microwave above a gas range, same model as s5 and success s9). Stage 0: squash grasped at 132, released into the wooden bowl at 239, stage 0 at 241. Stage 1: bowl grasped by the rim at 322 and carried to the high microwave. It hung tilted more than 45 deg from 552 (tipped 552-647) and was pushed only partly into the cavity (wrist 608-652); the official inside-check flickered on 634-655 while it was still held. The fingers opened at 648 with the bowl still tilted at the front lip; it slid back out at 652-660 and fell ~0.5 m onto the front-left burner of the range (668-688), landing upright with the squash still in it (stage 0 stays complete; bowl ends 0.48 m from the microwave interior). The policy did not notice. It closed the empty microwave (door contacts 705-890, closed at 844) and went to the keypad. Presses 1128-1245 landed on the bezel just below the 'Stop/Reset' / 'Start' row, as in s5, so the microwave was never turned on.
causal_chain: bowl carried tilted and released at the cavity lip at 648 -> slides out and falls onto the range 652-688 -> policy continues as if the bowl were inside: door closed 844, keypad presses 1128-1245 (also off START) -> bowl not in the microwave at timeout
self_recovery: none: it never looked back at the bowl on the range.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 1 condition held briefly (634-655) while the gripper still touched the tilted bowl, so the official check is satisfied at the lip of the cavity for a tilted bowl. Not a false positive at the end.
